https://snkrdunk.com/apparels/138599.headline: Pikachu VMAX CSR ask +22% in a week while the market was flat
https://snkrdunk.com/apparels/138599.text:
What's happening: The lowest PSA10 ask rose from ¥29,500 to ¥35,999 in 7 days, 14% above the recent sales median of ¥31,500, while the My-tier index barely moved (+0.3%).
Why: Likely sellers re-pricing upward after thin supply near ¥30,000; the sold prices rose too (median ¥31,500 vs ¥29,500 before). A search for a reprint of the set found no relevant news.
For you: ¥35,999 is far above your ¥29,000 limit and the ¥31,000 Buy line, so it stays Watch.
Watch: Whether sales keep clearing above ¥31,000, or the ask falls back toward ¥30,000.

https://snkrdunk.com/apparels/387059.headline: Ask jumped 7% while the rest of the market fell, on thinner trading
https://snkrdunk.com/apparels/387059.text: The lowest ask rose from ¥41,000 to ¥43,900 over a week in which my tier index fell 8%. Sales slowed sharply, from about 7.5 a day to 2.5, so the rise looks like sellers pulling cheaper listings rather than new demand. That is a guess from the data, not a confirmed cause. The ask sits above the Buy line (¥38,000) and your limit (¥35,000), so there is nothing to do; watch whether sales pick back up before treating this as a new floor.

https://snkrdunk.com/apparels/408333.headline: Trading has tripled at a flat price; the ask sits just above your limit
https://snkrdunk.com/apparels/408333.text:
What's happening: PSA10 sales ran at 7.0 a day this week against 2.0 a week ago, while the lowest ask moved only +2% to ¥76,500. Sales cluster at ¥75–76k, and 15 of the 20 cheapest asks are within 15% of the low.

Why: Likely buyers absorbing supply at a steady price rather than a price jump. I found no news of a reprint or a new Pikachu ex product that explains it; the only 30th-anniversary announcement I read (30th CELEBRATION, 9/16) lists reprints of other cards, not this one.

For you: The ask is about ¥6.5k above your ¥70,000 limit and above the ¥70,000 Buy line. While the My-tier index is still down more than 10% on the month, the correction rule means only a listing at or below ¥59,500 is a Buy.

Watch: Whether sales keep running at 5+ a day. If they slow while asks stay at ¥76k, the buying has probably dried up.
